fullContentHtml:
Railway RRB JE 04/2026 Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released Admit Card for the recruitment of Junior Engineer JE, CMA & DMS on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment was released for 4029 posts. Applications for the RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 14 August 2026 to 13 September 2026. The CBT-I examination is going to conducted on 27, 28 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Railway RRB JE Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 14 August 2026
  • Last Date for Apply : 13 September 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 15 September 2026
  • Form Correction / Modified Date : 16-25 September 2026
  • Application Status : 07 October 2026
  • Exam Date : 27, 28 October 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Railway RRB JE 04/2026 Admit Card 2026?

Railway RRB JE 04/2026 Admit Card 2026 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
